notes: 'Other hats' (158 entries) dissolved: named makers' models became archetype versions (Stetson Boss of the Plains, Open Road, Stratoliner; Akubra Cattleman; Lock Coke, Rollable Panama, Classic Boater (kept in m), Harrison (crochet trilby, under Trilby); Kangol Bermuda Casual, Spitfire; Laulhère Authentique, Basque, Bulle, Campan, Che, Véritable). Duplicate 'Boss of the Plains'/'Stratoliner' under John B. Stetson Company vs Stetson merged into Stetson. Generic shapes became kinds (Bowler, Top hat, Boater, Pork pie, Homburg, Beret, Panama, Sun hat, Cowboy hat) or types. Women's fashion hats (cloche, pillbox, fascinator, picture, cartwheel, halo, half hat, peach basket, boudoir cap) went to a new kind 'Cloche & women's millinery'. Fur hats (ushanka, papakha, shtreimel) became archetypes of Fur hat; boonie and pith helmet archetypes of Sun hat. Remaining regional, religious, uniform, historical and novelty hats listed as types of 'Traditional, ceremonial & uniform headwear' grouped by faith/region (no models); cross-link to Traditional dress shelves and F4. Deerstalker kept there as a type but may belong in Caps & knit headwear. Left out (not confirmed on a retrieved page): Akubra Snowy River, Lock Monaco and St. Louis (shape unknown), Greeley and Atwood, Homero Ortega and Optimo, Elósegui, Stüssy bucket, Bailey/Brixton pork pies, Kangol Bermuda Casual launch year. Pre-Wikipedia 'Breton' (women's hat) and 'Slouch', 'Legionnaire', 'Mushroom hat', 'Printer's hat', 'Smoking cap', 'Whoopee cap', 'Gaitou', 'Humao', 'Liangmao', 'Baishamao', 'Jaapi', 'Mathal', 'Kova tembel', 'Upe', 'Icelandic tail-cap', 'Kłobuk', 'Kołpak', 'Börk', 'Labbadeh', 'Makapili', 'Chilote cap', 'Birke topi', 'Planter's hat', 'Yishan Guan', 'Zhanjiao Futou', 'Liuheyitong mao', 'Phrygian cap', 'Šubara', 'Tembel hat', 'Karakul' not listed individually (covered by group types or as fur-hat/sun-hat/bucket variants; tembel hat is a bucket-hat regional name). Wikidata helper returned empty results, so all sources are fetched Wikipedia, UNESCO and maker pages.
